name: Mixed controller review packet starter composition
purpose: Show how independent workbook, memorandum, and correspondence templates can be composed without placing world facts in reusable assets.
world_fact_policy: All facts, identities, dates, amounts, and source locators are supplied at instantiation from one approved world; none are stored in this manifest.
required_additional_components: At least one separately sourced authoritative record that owns the governing facts.
Any system exports or attachments referenced by instantiated artifacts.
A package-level provenance card and world-facts ledger outside the model-visible package.
composition_constraints: Do not promote the memorandum, workbook, or email to authority they do not own.
Do not force one visual style, voice, timestamp convention, or residue pattern across producers.
Resolve shared identifiers from the approved world while preserving producer-specific vocabularies.
Reject the package if any template token, template.invalid address, false approval, generator residue, or contradictory authoritative fact remains.
package_proof_expectations: render every paginated page and workbook sheet
run package-wide token, metadata, identity, and leakage scans
